categories.main_business_segments: Carlisle Companies operates two primary business segments: Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM) and Carlisle Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT). CCM focuses on premium roofing products and related technologies for commercial and residential buildings, while CWT provides high-performance waterproofing, moisture protection, insulation, and building envelope solutions. Both segments serve the construction industry with a focus on energy efficiency and sustainability.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced materials science and manufacturing processes, including single-ply roofing membranes (EPDM, TPO, PVC), polyisocyanurate and expanded polystyrene insulation, architectural metals, and integrated air/vapor barriers. Production emphasizes lean enterprise and Six Sigma principles through the Carlisle Operating System (COS), driving continuous improvement, waste reduction, and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Carlisle primarily serves contractors, building owners, and distributors in the non-residential and residential construction markets. Key end markets include commercial re-roofing, new construction, and energy-efficient building upgrades, with significant sales to large distributors such as Beacon Roofing Supply and ABC Supply Co., which together accounted for approximately 33.7% of consolidated revenues in 2024.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are in the United States, which accounts for over 90% of revenues, with additional manufacturing and distribution facilities in Canada and Europe (notably Germany, the Netherlands, the UK, and Romania). International sales are concentrated in Europe and North America (excluding the U.S.), with a smaller presence in other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Carlisle operates as a midstream manufacturer and supplier within the building products supply chain, producing finished roofing, waterproofing, and insulation systems that are sold primarily through distributors and directly to contractors and building owners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Carlisle’s Vision 2030 strategy emphasizes organic growth through innovation, operational excellence via COS, synergistic acquisitions, and sustainability leadership. R&D is focused on developing proprietary, energy-efficient, and labor-saving products, with increasing investment in new product development, sustainability initiatives, and integrated building envelope solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of building products and systems, including roofing membranes, insulation, waterproofing, and related accessories. Additional revenue streams include extended warranty contracts and, to a lesser extent, services related to training and support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Carlisle is one of four major manufacturers in the U.S. single-ply roofing industry and a leader in building envelope solutions. Key competitors include other large building products manufacturers with regional and product-specific competitors in both commercial and residential markets. The company differentiates itself through innovation, customer service, and long-term warranties.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Carlisle reported $5.0 billion in revenues, 9% year-over-year growth, and an operating margin of 22.8%. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 26.6%. The company has demonstrated strong earnings growth, margin resiliency, and significant capital deployment for acquisitions and share repurchases, positioning itself for continued mid- to high-single-digit growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Carlisle emphasizes innovative, energy-efficient, and labor-saving building envelope solutions that reduce carbon emissions and support sustainability goals. The company’s value proposition centers on the Carlisle Experience—delivering superior customer service, proprietary products, long-term warranties, and a comprehensive suite of solutions that address mega trends in energy efficiency, labor shortages, and re-roofing demand.
